LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
Notice Under Section 66 B (1)

NAMES of Mayors, Deputy Mayors and Chairmen, Vice Chairmen who are declared appointed in terms of Section 66 B (1) ofthe Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, for each Local Authority situated in the Administrative Districts described inColumn I of the said Schedule, described in the corresponding entry in Column II of the Schedule hereto, are as specified inthe corresponding entry in Column III of the said Schedule.
